text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Sixty hundred and sixty is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 1. There is hereby establish in Tawi-Tawi a college to be known as the Tawi-Tawi College of
Technology and Oceanography which shall extend to the Muslims and other cultural minority groups the
opportunities of college education and develop such other programs as will promote Muslim welfare and
hasten the economic development of the southernmost region of the Philippines."
